Lost Tower#001.src: Hey adventurer! Would you mind helping me for a second? I have a bit of a problem on my hands.
Lost Tower#001.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#002.src: A while ago, before {p} was destroyed, my family used to own quite an interesting book, that held knowledge of places and beings of great power.
Lost Tower#002.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#003.src: Unfortunately, a creature stole it from them during the attack that led to the destruction of {p}, and no one has seen it since.
Lost Tower#003.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#004.src: If you are willing to help, bring me [{~} Book of the Bones], I believe this book is now between the hands of skeletons, in an old tower in {p}.
Lost Tower#004.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#005.src: See if you can find this tower, one of the skeletons probably has the book somewhere in there.
Lost Tower#005.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#006.src: Find the lost tower in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lost Tower#007.src: Find the book in the tower, and bring it back to Laen.

Lost Tower#008.src: Bring back the book to Laen.

Lost Tower#009.src: Great! This will be very interesting to read, thank you!
Lost Tower#009.speaker: Laen
